text: {"name": "llc_conn_process", "confidence": "medium", "docstring": "Processes an LLC connection descriptor by dispatching connection initialization or RX-context handling and returning the resulting status or context pointer.", "subsystem": "bt", "var_renames": {"v2": "conn_ctx", "v4": "conn_status", "v5": "result", "v6": "desc_state", "v7": "desc", "v12": "rx_ctx", "v13": "conn_idx"}, "struct_hints": [{"offset": 68, "meaning": "LLC connection context pointer in descriptor"}, {"offset": 36, "meaning": "descriptor state/type bits, tested against 0x300000 and 0x380000"}, {"offset": 8, "meaning": "connection status/flag word in connection context"}, {"offset": 13, "meaning": "connection index/identifier byte used to index LLC tables"}, {"offset": 340, "meaning": "abort or completion flag pointer/value in connection context"}]}
